name: RBI FREE-AI Framework (2025)
source: Reserve Bank of India, FREE-AI Committee Report (August 2025): 7 Sutras, 26 recommendations
changelog: 2025.1.0: migrated from sutras.validator.ts with the Phase 0 corrected recommendation references; results unchanged.

clauses.name: Trust is the Foundation
clauses.gap: No board-approved AI policy reference. REC 14 mandates a board-approved AI policy.

clauses.name: People First
clauses.gap: MEDIUM/HIGH risk model without human oversight. REC 16 requires human-in-the-loop.

clauses.name: Innovation over Restraint
clauses.gap: Autonomous model without defined scope boundary. REC 16 requires clear autonomous action limits.

evidence.bias_test: Bias-test report attached as evidence artifact
evidence.declared: Fairness sutra declared in model registration

gap.needs_evidence: No bias-test evidence attached. MEDIUM/HIGH risk requires a documented bias-test artifact, not a declaration.
gap.not_declared: Fairness & Equity sutra not declared. Bias testing must be documented.

clauses.name: Accountability
clauses.gap: No accountability chain (owner team) defined. REC 14 requires the AI policy to set out accountability.

clauses.name: Understandable by Design
clauses.gap: No explainability mechanism declared for MEDIUM/HIGH risk model (Sutra 6: Understandable by Design).

gap.no_red_team: {tier} risk model with no red-team exercise on record. REC 20 asks for red teaming at a frequency proportionate to risk, and after material changes.
gap.red_team_stale: {tier} risk model last red teamed {redTeamAge} days ago; REC 20 interval for {tier} risk is {redTeamInterval} days.
gap.no_drill: {tier} risk model with no passed BCP drill on record. REC 21 requires business-continuity plans for AI systems to be tested.
gap.drill_overdue: {tier} risk model's last passed BCP drill was {drillAge} days ago; the drill interval is {drillInterval} days (REC 21).
